sn36.10:1.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā || || 4
sn36.10:1.3: Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā || || 5
sn36.10:1.4: Sukhavedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati sukhā vedanā ||
sn36.10:1.5: tasseva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ sukhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā sā nirujjhati || sā vūpasammati || || 6
sn36.10:1.6: Dukkhavedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati dukkhā vedanā ||
sn36.10:1.7: tasseva dukkhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitam dukkhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca uppannā dukkhā vedanā sā nirujjhati || sā vūpasammati || || 7
sn36.10:1.8: Adukkhamasukkhavedaniyam bhikkhave phassam paṭicca uppajjati adukkhamasukhā vedanā ||
sn36.10:1.9: tasseva adukkhamasukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjam vedayitam adukkhamasukhavedaniyam phassam paṭicca uppannā adukkhamasukhā vedanā sa nirujjhati sā vūpasammati || || 8
sn36.10:1.10: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave dvinnaṃ kaṭṭhānaṃ saṅghaṭṭanasamodhānā usmā jāyati tejo abhinibbattati || tesaṃ yeva kaṭṭhānam nānābhāvā vinikkhepā yā tajjā usmā sā nirujjhati sā vūpasammati || || 9
sn36.10:1.11: Evam eva kho bhikkhave imā tisso vedanā phassajā phassamūlakā phassanidānā phassapaccayā
sn36.10:1.12: tajjam phassam paṭicca tajjā tajjā vedanā uppajjanti ||
sn36.10:1.13: tajjassa tajjassa phassassa nirodhā tajjā tajjā vedanā nirujjhantīti || ||
